title: Inventory Total
prompt: A small shop tracks products by quantity and unit price. Write a function that returns the total value of the inventory by multiplying quantity by price for each item and adding the results.

explanation.beginner: Start by identifying what the function receives and what it must return. For Inventory Total, read the story as a simple input-to-output rule: A small shop tracks products by quantity and unit price. Write a function that returns the total value of the inventory by multiplying quantity by price for each item and adding the results. Work through one small example by hand, then write the steps in JavaScript using plain variables before worrying about making the code shorter.
